dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY books with INC extension, MCP (middleware) calls, and LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM pattern typical of ORCA system programs.
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(2000)
JMA Open Source License copyright header
PERFORM ... UNTIL pattern, no EXEC CICS/SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - provisional receipt data creation (仮収納データ作成) for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: ORCR0600 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that creates provisional receipt/payment data (仮収納データ作成). It processes patient insurance combination records, diagnosis accounting data, and hospitalization accounting records to generate receipt billing data, with support for cancellation processing, real-time preview, and various insurance types including workers compensation and public nuisance insurance.

notable_features: 28 COPY book inclusions (INC files) for record layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
MCP (middleware) DB access pattern via MCPDATA
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments and string literals
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP DB layer
STOP RUN vs EXIT PROGRAM conditional based on SHELLID
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing garbled display of Japanese characters in the comment block. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 110201 bytes (2555 lines total), but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
